metadata.scope: Official/public architecture-related project records likely to complement, rather than replace, HED listing and planning decision lanes.
metadata.selection_note: Kept 31 higher-signal official/public project records from Belfast City Council, DfC, DfI, Translink, Queen's University Belfast, and Ulster University. Dates are official page/report dates or project-stage ranges, not inferred outcome dates.
